measured_values_reason: Null by seed/contract.yaml's own convention: every quantity recorded null is measured at Phase 1 build time on the grading host and never authored at Phase 0. The two macro AP bands are two bands and not one, because the in-distribution split and the held-out-country split are different distributions and normalizing both on one band would assert they are the same; shift_floor and shift_knee are therefore separate nulls rather than aliases of floor and knee. The three host constants are the analytic latency model's coefficients, measured single-tenant at Phase 1 and rotated within a disclosed plus or minus 8 percent band between attempts; authoring any of them here would invent a measurement the bytes have not earned.
